card.name: Year digits in North Korea history
card.fires_on: Single digits inside a year or year range (like the 9 in 1994 or 8 in 1980s) in text about North Korea's history and economy.

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a four-digit year, in a passage about North Korean leaders, famine or decline.
modes.example: North Korea then suffers a famine from 19<<9>>4 to 1998.

modes.label: Digit in a year range or plan dates
modes.description: A digit in the second half of a year range for economic plans or trade history in Korea.

card.writes: It pushes down Korea-related words such as Korea, Korean and Seoul, so the model does not repeat the country name after the digit.
card.plain: It fires on the digits of dates in passages about North Korea's history, and holds back the word Korea right after them.
